assumptions.text: A bad or missing results.json is now caught before any memory write, and then no FIX return to build runs. Before, it was checked after the suite.
Re-running accept after an escalation repeats reflect and write_back on the slice branch. The north star can get duplicate Reported lines. I added no dedupe guard.
The verified commit is HEAD after the last passing suite and checks. This includes the FIX commit if build made one.
The heading match is any markdown heading line (leading #) that contains the name, so a heading like '### D7 — ...' matches.
The def match allows leading indentation, so it also finds methods.
The slice repo's suite command is `pytest tests -q`, with no xdist and no `bash tests/run.sh`. The `-n auto` flag needs pytest-xdist, which the running Python may not have.
The fixture assumes the Python running the tests has pytest installed. If it doesn't, the task and suite commands in the slice repo will fail.
